featured_reviews.name: Prakash kotian
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Sumo Icecream Adda yesterday and finally got to try their Korean Mango Ice Cream along with some other varieties 🍦🥭✨
Honestly, the experience was amazing! The best thing I noticed was that the ice creams didn’t taste like those regular artificial flavor ones. You can actually feel the real mango taste in every bite, like they’re using pure mango instead of just syrup or flavor essence. That natural fruity taste made it super refreshing and premium.

The texture was another level — very smooth, creamy, soft, and rich. Every flavor I tried had its own unique taste and felt different from normal ice creams available everywhere. The Korean Mango Ice Cream became my personal favorite because of how fresh and natural it tasted. The sweetness was perfectly balanced, not too much, and the creamy texture made it even better 😍

You can really tell that Sumo Icecream Adda focuses on quality and unique flavors instead of just making overly sweet ice cream. Their variety collection is also very impressive, so if someone loves trying new desserts or international-style ice creams, this place is definitely worth visiting.

Overall, a very refreshing and satisfying experience. Good ambience, unique flavors, real fruit taste, and premium quality ice creams — highly recommended for all dessert lovers 🔥🍨

featured_reviews.name: Bhavin Marathe
featured_reviews.review_text:
After trying the Korean ice creams at Sumo Icecream Adda, I also had their Mango Mastani with fresh fruits 🥭🍨✨
And honestly, it was one of the most satisfying mango desserts I’ve had in a long time! The presentation itself looked amazing, fully loaded with fresh fruits, thick mango shake, creamy ice cream, and rich dry fruit toppings. From the very first sip and bite, you could actually feel the freshness and real mango taste instead of artificial flavoring. That’s what made it stand out for me 😍

The texture was super thick, creamy, and refreshing at the same time. The combination of chilled mango drink, soft ice cream, and fresh fruit pieces made every spoon feel premium and delicious. It had the perfect balance of sweetness — not too sugary, just smooth and naturally tasty. The fresh fruits added a nice juicy feel, which made the whole dessert even more enjoyable.

What I really liked about Sumo Icecream Adda is that their desserts don’t feel cheap or overly flavored. Everything tastes fresh, rich, and made with proper quality ingredients. The Mango Mastani especially gave that authentic fruity taste which mango lovers will definitely enjoy.

If you love mango desserts, thick shakes, or refreshing summer treats, then this Mango Mastani is a must-try. The quantity, taste, quality, and presentation were all worth it. Definitely one of the best combinations for anyone who enjoys real fruit-based desserts 🔥🥭🍦

Through our Mango Mastani, we also tried to introduce the authentic sweetness and rich flavor of Konkan mangoes to our customers ❤️ Your words about the texture, balance of sweetness, presentation, and overall quality genuinely mean a lot to us. featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve tried many flavours from Apsara Ice Cream, but my absolute favourite is Brownie Blast. Especially with the chocolate wafer cone. The cone is perfectly crisp and well-cooked, with just the right amount of chocolate coating and colorful sprinkles that make it look super cute and taste even better!

The Brownie Blast flavour has a rich chocolate base with mini brownie pieces mixed in. It’s not overly sweet, and also not too dark or bitter, just the perfect chocolate balance. It’s indulgent without being heavy, and every bite is a treat!

The parlour has a fun and cozy vibe, with a neon sign board, one big swing, and 2–3 tables. Offering plenty of space to sit and enjoy.

Overall, a great experience. Highly recommend this flavour for all chocolate lovers!
